name: vistack
description: Route engineering work through explicit playbooks, evidence gates, and merge-ready draft PRs in Codex or Claude Code.

interface.longDescription: Route a bug, feature, refactor, investigation, or design task through a checkable playbook in Codex or Claude Code. The workflow keeps run state resumable and stops at merge-ready draft PRs without merging.
defaultPrompt: Use viStack to plan and implement this change.
Investigate this issue with evidence only.
Verify this diff against its acceptance criteria.
